title: Rapid prospectivity signal catalog and latency-sensitivity playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, operational 'signal catalog' and playbook that helps product and sales quickly assess emergent open-models and vendor variants for enterprise readiness. The deliverable is a one-page scoring template + catalog entries and a set of latency-sensitivity decision rules that map customer profiles to fallback and procurement triggers.
background: We consistently see new model variants (quantized, sharded, distilled) appear across open-source ecosystems. Sales and Solutions teams need fast, defensible heuristics to decide whether to recommend a Hosted/ Dedicated/Private deployment or an enterprise procurement path. Current artifacts are long-form and slow to produce. This ticket creates a repeatable lightweight process and assets.
goals: Ship a 1-page scoring template for emergent models that includes latency buckets, quantization risk, and cost-per-1k-token estimates
Populate the catalog with 12 high-priority model entries covering representative variants (e.g., float16, 4-bit quant, sharded weights)
Produce latency-sensitivity rules that map buyer personas (low-latency search vs. high-throughput batch) to recommended deployment and fallback strategies
scope_in: Catalog of 12 model variant entries with measured 95th percentile latency on standard short/long context workloads
Decision matrix tying customer persona to deployment recommendation
success_metrics: Sales and Solutions can complete signal triage in < 45 minutes (measured in 6-week pilot)
Catalog reduces time-to-procure recommended fallback model by 30% vs baseline
Positive qualitative feedback from 3 pillar customers during pilot
tasks: Define scoring fields and weights (latency, quantization fragility, availability risk, per-token cost)
Run microbenchmarks for candidate models on standard workloads (short ctx 256, long ctx 2048)
Draft Confluence one-pager and CSV template
Pilot with Solutions on two real deals and record time-to-triage
decisions: Benchmark targets: measure p50/p95 memory and latency on dedicated 8xA100 and hosted smallest GPU variant
Scoring weight: latency 35%, cost 25%, fragility 25%, availability 15% (initial)
tradeoffs: Favor quick triage (low friction) over exhaustive measurement; accept reduced precision in cost estimates
Excluding legal/contract work keeps playbook lean but requires handoff to GtM before procurement
risks: Rapid model churn may invalidate catalog entries within 6-8 weeks
Benchmarks on hosted infra may not generalize to customer private on-prem setups
